title: AI Multi-Agent Orchestrator
codeSnippet:
class AgentOrchestrator:
    def __init__(self, rag_engine, tools):
        self.rag = rag_engine
        self.tools = tools
        self.agents = [ResearchAgent(), CodeAgent(), QAAgent()]
    
    async def execute_task(self, prompt: str) -> ExecutionResult:
        # 1. Retrieve domain context via Vector RAG
        context = await self.rag.retrieve_top_k(prompt, k=5)
        # 2. Plan and delegate to specialized subagents
        plan = await self.agents[0].create_plan(prompt, context)
        return await self.dispatch_parallel(plan)
desc: Autonomous multi-agent orchestration framework featuring Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), intelligent subagent delegation, dynamic tool execution, and automated QA pipelines.

title: Global-NewsStream-Enterprise-Lakehouse-Real-Time-Media-Intelligence-Platform
codeSnippet:
from airflow import DAG
from airflow.operators.bash import BashOperator
from datetime import datetime

with DAG(
    dag_id='news_lakehouse_etl',
    start_date=datetime(2023, 1, 1),
    schedule_interval='@daily',
    catchup=False,
) as dag:
    scrape_news = BashOperator(task_id='scrape_data', bash_command='python /app/scrapers/main.py')
    load_bronze = BashOperator(task_id='load_bronze_layer', bash_command='python /app/pipelines/load_minio.py')
    process_silver = BashOperator(task_id='process_silver_layer', bash_command='python /app/pipelines/transform.py')
    load_gold = BashOperator(task_id='load_gold_layer', bash_command='python /app/pipelines/aggregate.py')

    scrape_news >> load_bronze >> process_silver >> load_gold
desc: Developed a comprehensive, distributed enterprise lakehouse platform for real-time ingestion, processing, and visualization of news articles, providing critical media intelligence. Engineered a robust data pipeline utilizing a medallion architecture, ETL/ELT processes, and containerized services to manage and analyze high-volume, dynamic data streams.
features: End-to-end distributed platform for real-time news data ingestion, processing, and visualization.
Implemented a robust Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold layers) within a Data Lakehouse (MinIO, PostgreSQL).
Automated ETL/ELT pipelines orchestrated by Apache Airflow ensuring data quality and transformations.
Scalable deployment leveraging Docker and Kubernetes, with comprehensive monitoring via Prometheus and Grafana.
